_README: Machine-readable source-to-serve map for the Maharat email asset pipeline. GitHub is the source of truth, Ortto is the serve host (Ahmed's architecture). One row per image (header EN cover, header AR cover, body portrait) per instructor and class. Derived from context/instructors/_EMAIL-IMAGE-MANIFEST.md and _IMAGE-CATALOG.md. The human-readable companion is _EMAIL-ASSET-PIPELINE.md. The script scripts/email_asset_pipeline.py reads and writes this file. House style: no em dash, no en dash, no tatweel, Western numerals only. Status vocabulary: pending-fetch (source known, bytes not yet in github_path), fetched (bytes committed under github_path), pending-ortto (fetched, not yet on the Ortto serve CDN), served (ortto_serve_url is live). blocked carries a reason and never advances.
